answer: Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a sable header. Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a tide spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Producing 54 answers an epoch therefore costs 88 real forward passes, and the raven record lets any auditor recompute the check.
